$ proxy serve --help
Usage: proxy serve [options]

Print the listeners, the backend, the cache and the log of the proxy.

Options:
      --addr string               Address to listen on.            env PROXY_SERVE_ADDR, key serve.addr
      --admin-addr string         Address to listen on.            env PROXY_SERVE_ADMIN_ADDR, key serve.admin.addr
      --admin-tls-cert string     Certificate file.                env PROXY_SERVE_ADMIN_TLS_CERT, key serve.admin.tls.cert
      --admin-tls-key string      Key file.                        env PROXY_SERVE_ADMIN_TLS_KEY, key serve.admin.tls.key
      --backend-timeout duration  Timeout of a request.            default "30s", env PROXY_SERVE_BACKEND_TIMEOUT, key serve.backend.timeout
      --backend-url string        URL of the server.               default "http://localhost:9000", env PROXY_SERVE_BACKEND_URL, key serve.backend.url
      --cache-dir string          Directory of the cache.          env PROXY_SERVE_CACHE_DIR, key serve.cache.dir
      --cache-size int            Size of the cache in megabytes.  default "64", env PROXY_SERVE_CACHE_SIZE, key serve.cache.size
      --level debug|info|warn     Level of the log.                default "info", env PROXY_SERVE_LEVEL, key serve.level
      --tls-cert string           Certificate file.                env PROXY_SERVE_TLS_CERT, key serve.tls.cert
      --tls-key string            Key file.                        env PROXY_SERVE_TLS_KEY, key serve.tls.key

Global options:
  -c, --config file  Config file in JSON.                                                    env PROXY_CONFIG
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env PROXY_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ proxy serve --addr :443 --tls-cert public.pem --tls-key public.key
public ":443" with "public.pem" and "public.key"
admin  "" with "" and ""
backend http://localhost:9000 within 30s
cache "" of 64 MB, log info
[exit 0]

$ PROXY_SERVE_ADMIN_TLS_CERT=rotated.pem PROXY_SERVE_BACKEND_TIMEOUT=5s proxy -c proxy.json serve --cache-dir /var/cache/proxy --flag-debug
  OPTION             VALUE                   SOURCE
  --config           "proxy.json"            flag --config
  --addr             ""                      default
  --admin-addr       "127.0.0.1:9443"        key serve.admin.addr of proxy.json
  --admin-tls-cert   "rotated.pem"           env PROXY_SERVE_ADMIN_TLS_CERT
  --admin-tls-key    "admin.key"             key serve.admin.tls.key of proxy.json
  --backend-timeout  5s                      env PROXY_SERVE_BACKEND_TIMEOUT
  --backend-url      "http://10.0.0.7:9000"  key serve.backend.url of proxy.json
  --cache-dir        "/var/cache/proxy"      flag --cache-dir
  --cache-size       128                     key serve.cache.size of proxy.json
  --level            "warn"                  key serve.level of proxy.json
  --tls-cert         ""                      default
  --tls-key          ""                      default
public "" with "" and ""
admin  "127.0.0.1:9443" with "rotated.pem" and "admin.key"
backend http://10.0.0.7:9000 within 5s
cache "/var/cache/proxy" of 128 MB, log warn
[exit 0]

$ proxy serve >/dev/full
proxy: main: write the options: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
